items.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: And even in high school I started my own band. We used to play for dances, students in school would have their social clubs. And I had Richard Davis was a bass player in the band at that time.

ctx.x: Wow. That’s some deep thoughts. That’s good. At what point in your life did you really think that I’m going to make a living with this?

Well I guess after I got in the band in high school, then I began to really get serious about it. Because prior to that time, when I was taking piano lessons, I was mainly, I’d go out and play with the fellas around the neighborhood who were not into music. So I tended to want to do whatever they were doing. And then when I got to high school everybody that I was hanging out with were in the band. And we were all going either to jam sessions or we’d be jamming and playing and marching bands. Because the band in…
And what would your song list include for those kinds of gigs?
